confirmedIntegration.codeEdits: GitHub only; never Lovable AI chat or generation
confirmedIntegration.deployment: Existing authenticated database/deploy operations; version exact data changes in this repository before applying. Publishing a file alone does not add a database listing.

countingRules: Count only new distinct properties added by this campaign, absent from baseline, with confirmed live detail/feed visibility and photo review.
Deduplicate canonical source URLs, portal IDs, address/agent reference and cross-portal duplicates against all existing rows including rejected ones.
Do not resurrect previously rejected rows automatically.
Unverified candidates, duplicate entries, generic search pages, unknown photos and unexecuted SQL do not count.
qualityRules: Strict asking price below EUR 100,000; preserve original currency and dated FX evidence for non-EUR prices. Taxes, fees and renovation costs are separate.
Verify a direct active property listing and factual title, price, country, location and source; unknown facts stay null.
Habitable residential properties only. Exclude bare ownership, occupied/tenant-only investment, auctions, land-only, ruins or major unfinished renovation.
Visually inspect every selected photo. Only genuine photos of this exact property; prioritize attractive terrace/view, stone or white-village exterior, bright renovated interior or garden.
Use an explicit allowlist for card hero and detail gallery; omit ugly bathrooms, dark corridors, clutter, poor crops, collages, giant watermarks/arrows and unfinished interiors.
Keep material condition/ownership drawbacks in the description; attractive photo selection must not hide defects or imply a renovation.
Keep source attribution. Source-hosted preview URLs are not proof of paid-ad rights; no paid campaign, rehosting, AI beautification or messages to advertisers are authorized.
No fabricated votes, likes, verification dates, ROI, fees, scores presented as objective or owner confirmation.
